.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm, regression
    :tickets: 13817

    Fixed regression caused by :ticket:`8601` where
    :meth:`_sql.Select.filter_by` would raise
    :class:`_exc.AmbiguousColumnError` when selecting a mapped entity or
    attribute along with a SQL function, :class:`.hybrid_property` or other
    expression derived from that same entity, as the expression would be
    counted as a separate FROM clause entity.
